dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Optional category field that names each gauge. If omitted, each Value measure becomes its own gauge.

dataRoles.name: measure
dataRoles.description: Current value for each gauge. Multiple measures are supported; without a Category, each measure becomes its own gauge.

dataRoles.name: target
dataRoles.description: Optional target value for each gauge. Without a Category, bind one shared Target or one Target per Value measure.
